changes: Implemented kind-aware review-run binding recovery: relaxes id-recency requirement for pass-evidence while keeping stale/replay checks for open findings and non-pass results; added EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH guard fallback to strict materialHash; added regression smoke and flow-stability coverage; synced decision + lease docs to the kind-aware contract.
usage: In REVIEW, run lattice review_run_start/review_pass_set or lattice validate to exercise PASS/validation evidence paths; verify with lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-6c4d --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate before DONE.
expectedOutcome: Concurrent review_run_start calls should no longer strand a prior material-fresh pass, empty hash cases should not silently pass advisory checks, and stale material/finding changes must still invalidate evidence as expected.
actualTranscript: TEST gate passed with lattice validate --story=B-6c4d --json executing 30 configured commands. done_prepare PASS validation path; blocker was only missing summary.json and delivery-check before DONE. review_escalation_status now reports full-3x2 local quorum and clean flow after rerun. No runtime regressions observed in related proof-admissibility stories.
outcomeDiff: No remaining functional behavior difference against target: bugfix flow is now stable for PASS evidence and validation; final blockers are closeout artifacts, not code behavior.
limitations: Authority/prod receipt semantics are intentionally unchanged; this story improves local proof-assurance and evidence refresh semantics only. Existing high-risk consumers may still block in enforce mode based on stricter admissibility policies.
pitfalls: Flow initially regressed when stale non-pass evidence stayed visible; rerun and finalization required multiple review runs, review_escalation_status, and done_prepare loop to clear stale review evidence and closure blockers.
